trainers.instruction: Who would agree with each statement?

atoms.a: Starting school later would help students perform better.
A later start would make after school activities difficult to manage.
Students should learn to manage their time and go to bed earlier.
Students have different preferences for when school should start.
Which statement best describes how the students’ opinions are different?
b: Both students agree that school should start later, but one is more confident about it.
++Mei believes school should start later, while Mohammed thinks the current schedule should stay the same.
Mohammed thinks school should start later, while Mei believes the current schedule should stay the same.
Both students agree that school should start early.

atoms.a: What reason does Mohammed give for keeping the school schedule?
b: Students feel more alert in the morning.
++It teaches discipline and allows time for other activities.
It gives students extra time to sleep before school.
It is a healthier option.

atoms.a: What reason does Mei give for changing the school schedule?
atoms.sound: What reason does May give for changing the school schedule?
b: She would skip her first class.
++She would have better sleep and focus.
She would have time to do homework in the morning.
She would do sports in the morning

atoms.a: What idea do both students mention, even though they interpret it differently?
b: that schools should reduce homework
++that starting later would affect how the school day is organised
that students should not have after school activities
that they don’t like school

atoms.a: What is the key difference between London and Cornwall mentioned in the text?
b: Both regions start school at the same time.
++London has an earlier average start time than Cornwall.
Cornwall starts school earlier than London.
London has a later average start time than Cornwall.

atoms.a: Why can’t London have a later school starting time?
b: ++London has logistical problems with transport.
London has more people and schools.
London has no logistical reasons why it starts later.
London is the capital and has to be different.

atoms.a: What is the difference between Denys’ essay and the previous essays?
atoms.sound: What is the difference between Dennis’s essay and the previous essays?
b: He is giving a different opinion to Mohammed and Mei.
++He only states facts and does not give his opinion.
His essay criticises Mohammed’s and Mei’s opinions.
His essay supports Mohammed’s opinion.
